goal: NS Cloud Drive — Capture Application Screenshots & Enhance Visual Documentation (README & Docs)
acceptanceCriteria: 1. Capture high-resolution, pixel-perfect PNG screenshots of the core application screens and modals: Disks Dashboard, Options & Themes, Analytics Dashboard, Logs & Diagnostics, Transfer Center & History.
3. Embed screenshots into README.md with captions, visual tour, and structured markdown layout.
4. Create comprehensive docs/USER_GUIDE.md featuring full visual interface walkthrough.
5. Ensure full test suite passes with exit code 0 under Set-StrictMode -Version Latest (41/41 passed).

decisions.decision: Capture off-screen WPF screenshots using STA PowerShell and RenderTargetBitmap with full live mount and telemetry states.
decisions.rationale: By initializing the window off-screen (-3000, -3000) and populating the live drive statuses and dispatcher frame, we capture authentic, production-quality screenshots showing all drives mounted (G:, I:, T:) without interfering with active user displays.

decisions.decision: Create docs/USER_GUIDE.md as a dedicated visual user walkthrough.
decisions.rationale: Provides open-source users with a clear, illustrated guide to every feature (Dashboard, Transfer Center, Analytics, Options, Logs) and links seamlessly from the main README.

reviewFindings.findings: All 5 screenshots verified pixel-perfect; UTF-8 glyph encoding rules preserved ([char]0x...); markdown links verified; test suite 100% passing.
